test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: AI10 is related to YG12 in a certain way. In the same way, BJ20 is related to ZH22. To which of the following is CK30 related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed here is,

**For 'AI 10' related to 'YG 12':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a2b501da68d2a50ec0d84046e6a3f6ed864251af9784fdf0a386ce63c5ecd57.png] 

**For 'BJ 20' related to 'ZH 22':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5e4660d158ce7163989824163d51a0bc3d8847accf6e411be5a694e69742ba6.png] 

The consistent pattern observed is: **First letter -2, Second letter -2, Number +2**.

**Applying the same logic to 'CK 30':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7dae337801604092fe22d66cb205bd26567c77b11a559b5cd1d3da94b56100c0.png] 

Thus, CK 30 is related to **AI32**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
